nodes.text:
Symptoms to watch for: Coughing, wheezing, sore throat, and runny nose. These may worsen for high-risk individuals.

Simple precautions: Wash hands regularly, wear masks, avoid crowded places, and stay home if you're unwell. Don't panic, but stay informed.
